# <span id="aanchor150"></span> Meter Editor

Accessing the Meter Editor requires **System Process – Meter Edit – Can View** privileges. For additional details about Meter Editor access, see: [Meter Editor Access Privileges](Meter%20Editor%20Access%20Privileges.md). The Meter Editor contains much more detailed meter information than the [Meter Quick Create](../Meter%20Quick%20Create/Quick%20Create.md) screen.

Use the Meter Editor to create, edit, or delete a meter. You can also set the meter fluid phase, identify the import file location and set up reporting, validations, and other service functions.

The Meter Editor also includes 80 user-definable fields that can be free form entry or drop-down to accommodate data points not built into the Meter Editor.

<div class="procedure">

To access the Meter Editor:

Go to **Setup** \> **Meter** \> **Editor**.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 680;height: 553;" />

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Meter Selector">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Meter Selector</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Meter Selector">

While creating or editing a meter, users can use the Meter Selector to edit the system, number, and name of a meter. For existing meters, this is the only location where these values can be updated.

When updating a meter number and saving, the system message 8 and the meter message 8 “Meter number changed” will be generated.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Details">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Meter Editor Details</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Details">

The following items are available on the Meter Editor screen:

- **Refresh** - Reload the meter from the database

- **New** - Create a new meter

  A fluid phase of liquid is only available with the **FLOWCAL Liquids** module.

- **Edit** - Enable data edit mode

- **Copy** - Copy the selected meter and generate a new meter, maintaining the data from the original meter

- **Delete** - Delete the selected meter

- **Save** - Saves changes to data; only enabled when in New or Edit mode

- **Cancel** - Cancel changes; only enabled when in New or Edit mode

- **Exit** - Exit the Meter Editor screen

- **Notes** - Enter or edit a note for the selected meter by right-clicking the Meter Editor screen while a meter is selected.

  Notes that have been added through the Notes screen can be accessed throughout the application (e.g., from the Volume Editor). When the selected meter includes a note that has been added using this method, the note icon 

<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="icon" style="width: 15;height: 15;" /> in the Object Selector displays in color when that meter is selected.

- **Src Assigns.** - Open the Quality Source Assignment Viewer with the meter number pre-populated

- **Open Data** - Open the Volume Editor with the meter number pre-populated and the current month/year

- **Location Info** - Display the meter’s associated location relationships

- **Close Dates** - Open the Meter Data Close Dates screen with the meter number pre-populated for all dates

- **User Access** - Display users and groups with access to the selected meter

  User/group access to meters is only relevant for companies that maintain object-level security. Most companies do not restrict access on a per-meter basis.

- **Test Reports** - For TESTit enabled meters, the **Test Reports** button is available immediately below the **Exit** button. For TESTit 2 Integrated, this button will display the test reports for the meter. You can then open each one to see the details or make edits.

  With TESTit 3 Integrated, test reports will display when you click the **Test Reports** button, but a PDF is opened for each record. Edits must be made within TESTit 3.

  This feature requires TESTit Integrated.

</div>
